about: The crypt's Forgotten ossuary (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): A second secret room behind cracked rock: a small floating slab, its reward for each wizard as the party steps in. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), sockets on its east and north and west sides for the bridges. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_secret_b_ground.tscn and its art from this.
